bear_assumptions: 2030 revenue reaches KRW 90 billion, gross margin falls to the high-40s, terminal operating margin stays near break-even, Q-series adoption remains niche, capex and cash burn reduce net financial assets to KRW 150 billion, dilution reaches 16.0 million shares, and the market applies 2x sales.
base_assumptions: 2030 revenue reaches KRW 180 billion, gross margin holds near 52%, terminal operating margin reaches about 12%, actuator exports and Q-series scale without mass humanoid adoption, net financial assets settle near KRW 200 billion, dilution reaches 15.5 million shares, and the market applies 5x sales.
bull_assumptions: 2030 revenue reaches KRW 400 billion, Q-series becomes a major global platform, humanoid programs convert into repeat paid volume, gross margin stays in the mid-50s, terminal operating margin reaches about 20%, net financial assets remain KRW 240 billion, diluted shares stay near 15.0 million, and the market applies 10x sales.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after a substantially lower price or auditable humanoid design wins, recurring revenue and durable margins lift the probability-weighted and base returns above every canonical gate; downgrade the operating thesis if Q-series or AI Sapiens launch slips, repeat paid orders remain undisclosed through 2027, margins return below break-even, inventory fails to convert, exports reverse, or capital deployment does not create measurable per-share returns.
